summary: ZK International Group filed a Form 6-K disclosing abrupt leadership changes effective September 10, 2026. Chairman Jiancong Huang resigned as director and board chairman, and CFO Xiaofen Jin resigned as chief financial officer; both cited no disagreement over operations, policies, or practices. The remaining board elected Ruihong Ma as Chairman and CFO, filling both vacancies simultaneously. No stake, price, premium, advisor, or closing terms were disclosed. The filing maps to a US Form 8-K Item 5.02 officer/director change. Watch for follow-on 6-Ks on interim finance leadership, audit-committee oversight, or strategic shifts under the consolidated Ma role.
